title: Correct final charge
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for the charge on sphere B must be 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ C.

title: Horizontal distance calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the horizontal separation between the spheres using the geometry of the setup and the given rod length.

title: Force equilibrium analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply static equilibrium to sphere B, resolving forces along the incline or horizontally to relate the Coulomb force to the weight.

title: Coulomb's Law application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Coulomb's Law to relate the calculated electrostatic force to the charge and separation distance.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates consistent unit conversion (e.g., cm to m, g to kg) throughout the solution.

title: Incorrect force resolution
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly resolves the weight component or misidentifies the angle for the force balance on the inclined plane.

title: Separation distance error
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student uses the vertical rod length directly as the separation distance between the charges, ignoring the horizontal offset.
